children: Sprouts Farmers Market appointed Chief Operating Officer Nick Konat as its next chief executive, succeeding Jack Sinclair.
Sinclair, CEO since 2019, will transition to the role of executive chairman effective Jan. 4, the supermarket chain said Tuesday.

"The Board and I have spent significant time and consideration developing our succession plan, and we believe that now is the right time to transition Sprouts to its next generation of leadership," Sinclair said.
Konat joined Sprouts as COO in 2022, and previously worked as chief merchandising officer at Petco Health and Wellness. He has also worked at Target and Accenture.
The company also said Joe Fortunato will serve as its lead independent director beginning Jan. 4.
